newsitem.title: USA: Ship hits New Orleans Riverwalk, injures dozens.
newsitem.headline: Ship hits New Orleans Riverwalk, injures dozens.

text.p: A freighter slammed into the New Orleans Riverwalk, an elevated strip of expensive stores overlooking the Mississippi River, on Saturday afternoon, injuring dozens of shoppers, authorities said.

The Coast Guard confirmed that the Liberian-registered freighter the MV Brightfield apparently lost power as it moved under a bridge near downtown New Orleans and hit the Riverwalk, adjacent to the downtown Hilton Hotel about 2:15 p.m. CST (2015 GMT).

"Details are still sketchy, but initial reports indicate at least part of the Riverwalk collapsed," a Coast Guard spokesman told Reuters. "There are casualties, several dozen. We don't know about deaths."
New Orleans police could not immediately be reached for details.
